# Tinlance Agent Developer Layer (TADL)

> TADL is Tinlance's declarative developer plane for governed AI-agent artifacts: skills, capabilities, agent profiles, workflows, harness adapters, evaluation, registry, provenance, security checks, and CLI validation.

TADL defines developer intent and artifact contracts. It does not grant execution authority. Tinlance Agent Platform remains authoritative for identity, authorization, policy, approvals, runtime, tools/MCP, sandbox, secrets, budgets, evidence, and audit.

## Getting Started

- [README](https://github.com/LloydCoder/tinlance-agent-developer/blob/main/README.md): Product positioning, quick start, installation, usage, and feature overview.
